summary: Microsoft's November Patch Tuesday fixed 1,094 flaws including an actively exploited Outlook zero-day that CISA KEV-listed alongside five more flaws (Chrome, BroadWorks, Barracuda, Openwave); N-able shipped Hotfix 2 for Able2Shell while Xen Orchestra auth-bypass exploitation joined newly disclosed GhostFrame ESXi and Railway supply-chain incidents.
